items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Tony was Tony's band, Tony Fusirat's band.

ctx.x: Leo Addy. August Schellang. Mm-hmm. Red Bullman, possibly. Yeah.
Well, and Lester Nelson, you told me you played with him, though. Oh, many times. Many, many times. With different leaders?
Yeah. Mostly in the same band?
